title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

title: Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our AI portfolio spans model development through to production inference at scale, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to make sure that infrastructure runs reliably, scales predictably, and gets AI engineers' work safely into production.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work keeps our AI portfolio reliable and performant for hospitals and aftercare providers who depend on it daily.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Our AI portfolio needs to run reliably and perform well. Thus it has to be properly monitored.

  • Capacity needs planning, support scaling initiatives, and ensure our systems remain stable as the company grows.

  • SageMaker models need to be continuously delivered, following AWS' best practices.

  • AI engineers need assistance with productionalizing AI workloads end-to-end, from code to container build, and rollouts using optimal deployment strategies.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to build, ship, and operate AI workloads reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes and Postgres

  • Inference: Bedrock, SageMaker, ClearML

  • Observability: Datadog, LangFuse, OTEL

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Plus various auxiliary tools for security, compliance and operations: DockerHub, Google as IdP, SonarCloud, VPNs, QuickSight, CDN, Snowflake, ETLs, etc.


Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

These are the knowledge and skills you need:

  • Experience with AWS (CloudFormation, IAM, ECR, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, KMS).

  • Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production (kustomize, HPA and KEDA based autoscaling).

  • Experience deploying SageMaker models, setting up custom inference containers (HuggingFace and/or OSS model) and endpoints (provisioning, autoscaling, and blue/green rollouts).

  • Familiarity with observability & LLMOps best practices and solutions (Datadog, Langfuse, LLM/GenAI tracing, OTel, CloudWatch).

  • Proficiency in Python, specifically with FastAPI and async task management.

  • Knowing how to set up ML/LLM GPU inference on EKS (GPU-backed instances, Nvidia driver/plugin).

  • Ability to own technical decisions and collaborate directly with other teams.

  • Troubleshooting, RCA, and resolving problems. When things get stressful, you stay cool headed and work through issues step by step, asking for support from SMEs when needed.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • This is a cross-functional role bridging the gap between applications and the platform. Ability to both explain complex concepts clearly to non-domain experts, and extract information through well-formed questions during verbal communication, is a must.

Bonus points:

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Self-hosting/home lab.

  • Nvidia Triton/vLLM or similar.

  • MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML, DVC, Vertex AI.

  • Slack and GitHub automations (bots, workflows, apps, etc.).

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

  • Language proficiency (at least English, but the more, the better).

You will also support the account team on key marketing activity. Your work lays the foundation for predictable, high-quality pipeline across our enterprise segment.

  • Run outbound prospecting (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) on strategic target accounts using concise, research-led messaging. Most of your quota will be expected to come from outbound.

  • Research the business issues affecting target accounts and profile key contacts before outreach.

  • Monitor social media for relevant trends and keywords, and share insights with the SDR, marketing and content teams.
  • Assist in the mentorship and training of new SDRs on process, technology and the company, and act as a leader and problem solver for the team.
  • Support the sales cycle through forecasting, data management and clear communication. Co-own sales tech stack reporting, review insights weekly and recommend changes to process, people or procedures.

title: Strategic Account Executive Enterprise - DACH
description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
  • A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
  • A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
  • Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
  • A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here!
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

The Mission 🪐
  • The Situation: Malt is cementing its position as the undeniable leader in the European freelance economy. While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the DACH Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption.
  • The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region. Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond.

    • Key Responsibilities ✨

    Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting

  • Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units).
  • Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new DACH Enterprise logos and concrete, multi-threaded stakeholder maps.
  • Metrics of Performance: Enterprise GSV Pipeline Generated and CRM forecast integrity.

    • Pillar 2: Deal Orchestration & RFP Command

  • Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams.
  • Output: Compelling, ROI-driven business proposals and precisely engineered enterprise pilot programs designed to prove undeniable platform value.
  • Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate.

    • Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation

  • Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams.
  • Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans.
  • Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum).

    • Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍

    Proven Mastery (What you have already built):

  • A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment.
  • Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups.
  • Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals.
  • Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English.

    • Skills You Will Deploy & Develop:

  • Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances.
  • C-Suite ROI Narrative Construction: Mastering the art of delivering disruptive narratives that challenge legacy customer assumptions and shift C-level perspectives on the "Future of Work."
  • Cross-Border Deal Structuring: Developing top-tier acumen in multi-country legal, financial, and compliance orchestration.

    • The Self-Selection Filter ❓

    This role is perfect for you if:

  • You are an elite hunter who actively enjoys the strategic friction of a complex enterprise sales cycle and navigating massive corporate red tape.
  • You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute.
  • You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings."

    • This role is NOT for you if:

  • You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers.
  • You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes.
  • You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition.

    • 30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁
  • Day 30: Submerge into our marketplace mechanics, master the Malt value proposition, and map the top tier of DACH global enterprise accounts. Output: Delivery of your fully architected account penetration strategy.
  • Day 60: Execute initial outreach, identify key Economic Buyers within target accounts, and begin orchestrating your first high-stakes pilot phases. Output: Establish a predictable, MEDDIC-qualified enterprise pipeline.
  • Day 90: Take absolute control of your Metrics of Performance. Lead your first complex RFI/RFP processes or MSA negotiations end-to-end and initiate scalable handover plans. Output: Secure early enterprise traction that directly impacts the regional bottom line.

    • How to join the mission? 🚀
  • First Call (45m): High-level alignment with Niko (Talent Acquisition Lead) to audit your background and entrepreneurial drive.
  • Strategic Deep Dive (60m): Interview with your future manager, Théo, to dissect your past enterprise deals and MEDDIC rigor.
  • Business Case (60m): A live simulation to assess your technical account development, localized prospecting skills, and C-level narrative delivery.
  • Final Vision Call (30m): Interview with our CRO to discuss Malt’s long-term scale and how your ambition aligns with our macro-economic growth.
    • Life on planet Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    🤝 Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris.
    💻 Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - 3 days office / 2 days home-office.
    🏖️ Annual leave: 30 days/year.
    📆 Sabbatical: 1 month paid sabbatical once you've been with Malt for 3 years.
    📈 Stock options: Every Malter is entitled to stock options. 
    🍽️ Lunch vouchers: 6,50€ per day / 15 days a month.
    🐶 Dog friendly office: In the heart of Munich/Berlin!
    ❓ Choose your Benefit: Transport reimbursement, Gym membership, Organic Food voucher or Rydes Mobility App.
    📚 Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow.
     
    Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 
     
    At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.
     
    Your profile may be subject to background screening. For more information see our candidate privacy policy.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
Talent Acquisition Intern

Deine Mission bei trawa

Bei trawa sind wir überzeugt: Die Energiewende beginnt bei den Menschen, die sie möglich machen. Du willst leistungsstarke Teams mit aufbauen und Recruiting von Grund auf so lernen, dass es wirklich Wirkung hat? Dann bist du bei trawa genau richtig.

Als Talent Acquisition Intern bist du das operative Rückgrat unseres Talent-Teams und sorgst mit uns dafür, dass die richtigen Menschen zu trawa finden. Du hältst unsere Prozesse am Laufen, gestaltest reibungslose Candidate Journeys, räumst administrative Hürden aus dem Weg und hilfst, ein Hiring-Erlebnis zu bauen, das hängen bleibt. So bringst du direkt mit voran, was uns antreibt: Unternehmen den Zugang zu echter, grüner Energie zu ermöglichen.

We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.

What you’ll do:

  • Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

  • Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

  • Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

  • Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

  • Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

  • Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

  • Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

  • Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue.

  • High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities.

  • Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

Why join

The biggest product choices are still ahead: how deep we go, where we expand and how everything fits together. Our product is already live with leading freight forwarders and this role will shape what comes next. You will build AI for the work that keeps global trade moving, alongside a team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will get meaningful equity in the company you help build.

title: Assistant Financial Controller
description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.

It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time.

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced.

  • Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why.

  • Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them.

  • Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting.

  • Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right.

  • Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors.

  • Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team.

  • Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience.

 

What you’ll need

  • An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates.

  • A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us.

  • Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through.

  • Curiosity and ambition, with the drive to push things forward and keep learning.

  • An interest in AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using it at work or in your own time and want to do more with it.

Nice to have:

  • Audit experience.

  • Experience using NetSuite.

  • Experience automating finance processes.

  • Exposure to R&D tax claims.

  • Experience in the tech sector.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

 

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will: 

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention. 
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

  • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

  • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

  • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

  • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   

  • Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.


It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

  • Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

  • Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

  • Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

  • Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

  • Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

  • History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI


Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

Mastery of Core Concepts

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

Efficient Implementations at Scale

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.


5. Rigorous Experimental Design

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.



Summary

Overall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:

  • A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principles

  • A talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutions

  • The capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversity

  • Keep the floor safe and ready: Clear cardboard, keep stations tidy and exits unobstructed, remove immediate hazards and report concerns promptly. Operate equipment only within your training and authorisation.

  • Work as one team: Support fellow Warehouse Operatives, cover neighbouring areas during breaks and promptly flag stock discrepancies or rotation errors.

Need to have

  • Warehouse knowledge: You understand warehouse operations, stock control, Health & Safety and GDP requirements, and put them into practice.

  • Attention to detail: You check medication strengths, order matches and storage conditions carefully. Accuracy is essential.

  • Ownership: You stay organised, anticipate what's needed and manage your area independently as priorities change.

  • Teamwork: You communicate clearly, flag issues early and bring reliable, consistent effort to every shift.

  • A hands-on approach: You can fulfil the role's physical duties, including continuous on-foot activity and routine manual handling.

Nice to have

  • Regulated operations: You've worked in regulated warehousing, logistics, pharmacy or healthcare.

  • Cold-chain knowledge: You understand how to handle temperature-controlled medicines and protect them throughout the packing process.

  • Warehouse systems: You've used warehouse management tools to track stock and identify discrepancies.

  • Equipment qualifications: You hold forklift or pump truck certification, or baler sign-off. If you don't, we'll provide training.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

title: Product Manager (Protocol)
description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

 

Role

Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work.

This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

  • Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

  • Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

  • Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

  • Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

  • Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

  • Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.

 

First 3 months

You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

 

First 6 months

You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

 

Must Have Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

  • Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration.

  • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about system design and constraints, engage deeply with engineers and researchers, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent product judgment: you can distinguish important user problems from requests, make principled tradeoffs, and focus teams on the work with the greatest impact.

  • Strong user discovery and synthesis skills, with the ability to uncover needs across different user types and turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear direction.

  • Experience leading cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

  • Ability to define success, use quantitative and qualitative evidence, and adapt direction as new information emerges.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in an async environment.

  • Comfort creating clarity and driving decisions in highly ambiguous contexts.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: you act without waiting to be told.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience in crypto, DeFi, traditional finance, or fintech.

  • Familiarity with lending markets, smart contracts, or permissionless protocols.

  • Experience shipping products with significant security, audit, regulatory, or governance considerations.

  • Experience working with research & development teams

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Compensation: $185K – $250K

title: Product Engineer
description:
Akur8 is one of the leading providers of insurance pricing and rating technology. Our mission is to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)


Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions.

Insurance companies use Akur8 to decide the price of millions of policies. We are looking for a talented Product Engineer to build the features they rely on to do it.

You will join the Pricing team, which builds the part of the Akur8 platform that Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners use to design, test and deploy their rates. Your mission is to scope, design and implement features that automate the rating process at insurance companies, from the first discussion of a client need to the feature running in production.

Much of the work is deciding what to build, not only building it. You will work with Product Managers, Designers, Actuaries and other Engineers to understand how insurers price risk, why they work the way they do, and where software can make them faster and more accurate. A good understanding of modelling, maths and logic is needed for this.

At its core, this is a hands-on software engineering role. You will spend significant time writing code, designing data models, building backend and frontend services, and ensuring the systems you ship are scalable, tested, and maintainable.

With AI being a reliable support for implementation, your main value will come from understanding the business context, the architecture and the data models as these will determine the quality of your deliveries. Our platform runs on AWS with Rust, Java, Python, and Angular. Prior experience with them is a plus.

You will work on the core of the platform from your first weeks and see the impact of your work on real clients.

In this role, you will:

  • Own product features end to end: clarify the need with the product team, scope it, design the solution, build it and follow it in production.

  • Turn requests from Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners into a clear scope, and challenge a requirement when a simpler solution meets the need.

  • Work in an AI native-engineering team: delegate implementation to deliver quickly, reviewing, test and own responsibility for everything you ship.

  • Balance delivery speed and robustness according to the client’s priorities.


Your work will help insurers price risk faster and more accurately, and will expand what Akur8 can offer its clients.

We’re looking for someone driven by outcomes: things done fast, done well, and useful to our clients.

  • You have completed or are finishing a PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or another quantitative field. No professional experience is required.

  • You have written code during your research and want to grow in software engineering practices such as testing, code review and system design, using AI coding assistants as part of your daily work.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, structure it and move it forward without waiting for a step-by-step brief.

  • You take a pragmatic approach to writing code: you care about solving the actual problem rather than chasing perfection, and you can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices.

  • You care about results more than about technology: you want to understand why a feature matters to the end user before deciding how to build it.


Prior experience with our tech stack (Rust, Java, Python, Angular, AWS) or the insurance space is welcome, but not required. We invest heavily in onboarding; what matters most is your curiosity and appetite to learn.

Important: You must possess an employment status: French or Schengen area nationality or a ‘carte de séjour’ that will allow you to work from our Paris office. We are equally open to the visa sponsorship of non-EU candidates as long as they are already in possession of their final diploma / attestation of their final academic results.

As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.

But it’s not all work, you’ll also be part of a dynamic team that enjoys spending time together and having fun, including karaoke, team lunches, playing sports as well as the occasional ‘happy hour’.

In addition to this, we will provide you with:

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus

  • Hybrid office / home office policy

  • 25 days of paid holidays + RTT

  • Gym membership with Wellpass

  • On-site gym facilities / corporate sporting activities

  • Excellent health insurance (including possibility of family coverage)

  • Swile lunch vouchers

  • Public transportation reimbursement + sustainable mobility allowance

  • Relocation support

  • Sponsored crèche access

Il s’agit d’un poste stratégique et opérationnel, particulièrement adapté à une personne qui apprécie de construire et d’améliorer des dispositifs dans un environnement international, en forte évolution et réglementé.

Risques opérationnels et gestion des risques

  • Suivre les risques opérationnels, non financiers et émergents, notamment les risques liés à la technologie, à la cybersécurité, à la fraude, à l’externalisation et aux processus métiers.

  • Préparer des reportings risques clairs et exploitables à destination de la Direction générale et des instances de gouvernance concernées.

Gouvernance et comités

  • Contribuer aux processus de reporting réglementaire et interne, notamment au rapport annuel sur le contrôle interne, ainsi qu’aux autres reportings réglementaires applicables.

Audits et contrôles réglementaires

  • Coordonner les audits externes, réglementaires et internes portant sur le contrôle interne, les risques opérationnels et la gouvernance.

  • Être le point de contact principal des auditeurs et des autorités compétentes sur les sujets de contrôle interne.

  • Coordonner le programme de contrôle périodique et suivre sa mise en œuvre conformément au plan d’audit défini.

title: Technical Project Manager - Engineering Delivery
description:
Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution.

You will work across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to keep delivery on track, manage dependencies, identify risks early, and help turn delivery challenges into clear actions and decisions.

We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering.

The role

Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams, working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives.

This role combines ownership of our engineering delivery processes with hands-on execution. You will be responsible not only for running these processes, but also for continuously improving how we plan, coordinate and track delivery across the organization.

Process ownership

You will own and continuously improve:

  • engineering delivery planning processes
  • delivery tracking and reporting
  • cross-team coordination and dependency management.

You will build on our existing practices and ClickUp workflows, identifying what can work better and evolving the processes as the organization and product develop.

Delivery execution

Day to day, you will:

  • track delivery across teams and releases
  • coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams
  • identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early
  • challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments
  • coordinate next steps when delivery is at risk
  • provide clear visibility on delivery status and progress.

description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

  • Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.
  • On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.
  • Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.
  • Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.
  • Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.
  • AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.
  • Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product.

You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up.

Your mission

title: Public Sector Partnerships Lead - France
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

In this role, you will:

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)

  • Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

  • Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

  • Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary)

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

  • Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)

  • Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across France, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

  • Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — including EU-level developments given France's influence in shaping EU AI policy.

  • Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

  • Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

  • Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

Who you are:

  • You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

  • You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

  • You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

  • You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

What you bring:

Primary requirements

  • 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

  • A wide, current network of contacts across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs, including in healthcare, education, and transport. Prior government or grands corps experience is a plus but not required if network breadth is strong.

  • Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

  • Contacts or experience navigating EU institutions or other major European markets is a plus.

Also required

  • Strong knowledge of the French and EU AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.

  • Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

  • Public policy experience across France.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

  • Fluency in English and French.

Location

This role is located in France.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
